column1: # Modality (and the N5-49..51 constructions). steps: endings on the predicate, then words; @HOST = the host of a
# copula word, =NOUN/CASE = a noun with its particle (spoken fusions apply: 것이 → 게 in dialogue), a bare word
# is literal. tense: inner = -었- on the predicate before the steps, outer = on the last
# word. neg: where and how the polarity goes (inner-level = on the predicate, long or short by level; inner-long,
# outer-long = -지 않다; outer-supp = the last word's lexical negative).
